description: Register profiles for STE-Code linguistic flavor. Each register defines sentence-length limits, article requirements, and permitted intents for a specific documentation text type.

special_rules: Must name: what failed + what happens next.
error-message.violation_example: Connection to the database server at postgresql://db.internal:5432 has failed due to a network timeout. The system will attempt to reconnect automatically after a delay of 30 seconds.

special_rules: Conventional-commit type prefix exempt from vocabulary rules.
Prefixes: feat:, fix:, docs:, refactor:, test:, chore:, ci:, perf:
commit-subject.violation_example: This commit adds a new feature for user authentication and also fixes the bug with password reset

special_rules: Response descriptions: one field per sentence.
Must contain reason clause when non-obvious: 'because', 'so that'.
Example: 'Run npm install. You see Installing packages... in the terminal.'
Category prefix: Added, Changed, Deprecated, Removed, Fixed, Security.
